answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed if a randomly sampled task reveals fabricated work or duplicate control. A new identity therefore cannot cheaply flood the economy: the attacker must lock capital in every account and risks losing it when audited. To keep the test meaningful, auditors compare signed task histories and inspect evidence, not just account age; hollow profiles gain no trust from a jade badge or velvet branding alone. The defense raises the price of Sybils, though it cannot stop a wealthy attacker outright.
